messages:
maya: Heads-up — planning a shimless cutover to API/SDK 3.2.0 this Wed 10:00 PT. Main goals: no client-side code changes for supported clients, canary for 5% traffic, full ramp at +30m if all green. Who can own smoke and rollback readiness?

alex: I can own smoke. all unit/integration tests passed on main, PR #4823 merged. Verified agent header compatibility with our internal webclients. Quick sanity curl to exercise the new header routing: `curl -H 'X-Client-Version: 3.2.0' 'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate' -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'`

riley: thanks. question on client comms: do we email partners before the rollout or opt for in-product banners? customers on older clients (<=3.0) should be safe, right?

john: we said 3.0 and 3.1 remain supported for 60 days, so no forced breaks. recommend a short email to the top 20 integrators + in-product banner for others. I can draft the banner copy.

maya: perfect. smoke ownership: alex is primary, john backup. Riley — can you post the canary bucket IDs? we need an owners list for oncall.

riley: canary buckets: 10% bucket -> bucket-id:c-canary-10, 5% bucket (safety) -> c-canary-5. I'll tag them in the deploy config. oncall: @oncall-sre pls stand by 09:45 PT.

deploy-bot: Deploy window reserved: 2024-11-06T10:00:00-08:00 PT. Canary config saved at /deploys/configs/3.2.0-canary.json

alex: smoke checklist (short):
- run sample generation against canary: `curl -H 'X-Client-Version: 3.2.0' 'https://api.canary.redwood.ai/v1/generate' -d '{"prompt":"smoke test"}'`
- confirm latency p95 < 300ms for short seqs
- check client_error_rate < 0.5% over the first 10m
- validate header routing fallback: send request without X-Client-Version -> should hit legacy proxy

maya: rollback plan (keep it extremely fast):
```
# rollback steps (ops)
kubectl set image deploy/redwood-canary proxy=redwood/proxy:stable-3.1.0 -n inference || true
kubectl rollout status deploy/redwood-canary -n inference --timeout=2m
# revert routing: update LB rule to legacy-proxy
/opt/deploy/bin/update-lb --set legacy-proxy
```

alex: note: we also built a temporary legacy shim tag `v3.1-legacy-proxy` that can be used in the rollback if the proxy image needs to serve older clients without header changes.

riley: metrics to watch (first 30m): `client_error_rate`, `token_throughput`, `p95_latency`, and `auth_failures` (client header mismatches). alert threshold proposal: client_error_rate > 0.8% or p95_latency > 500ms -> immediate pause and rollback.

john: i'll own post-deploy validation and the changelog publish. I'll post the release note link once it's ready: https://docs.redwood.ai/changelog/sdk-3-2-0

maya: can everyone add their thumbs-up when they can be available 09:45-10:30 PT? I'll start the canary at 10:00, monitor for 30 minutes, then decide ramp. :thumbsup:

alex: +1 (available)

john: +1

riley: +1, will monitor metrics dashboard and watch for auth regressions

oncall-sre: oncall-sre: will be standing by 09:30-11:00 PT. I have the rollback scripts preloaded.

maya: great — final note: if any client-compat regression shows up, we fall back to legacy proxy tag, notify partners, and open a P0 if root cause not found in 45m. Otherwise proceed with ramp at +30m. I'll post the deploy checklist in the runbook channel 08:00 PT tomorrow.

alex: sounds good. I'll kick off the smoke script 10:00 on the canary and report back.

riley: cheers, will prepare the banner copy and partner email draft now.

john: will assemble release notes and ping legal for the brief partner wording review.

maya: thanks everyone — see you Wed.
